_comment: Cautions library. No approved wording is installed. Each entry identifies the missing material and shows related legal sources. The app never generates or paraphrases official wording. Add approved wording only with an approval record (docs/LEGAL_REVIEW.md).

entries.title: Young person — statement explanation and waiver

body.missing_material: Service-approved youth statement explanation and waiver forms/wording.
body.purpose: Meeting the explanation and consultation requirements of YCJA s. 146(2) before a statement, and the waiver form requirements of s. 146(4).
body.applicable_circumstances: Statements by a young person less than eighteen years old in the circumstances described in s. 146(2).
accompanying_steps: Opportunity to consult counsel and a parent or appropriate adult (s. 146(2)(c)).
Waiver must be recorded on video or audio tape, or in writing signed by the young person (s. 146(4)).
documentation: Explanation given, language used, persons consulted, waiver record.
body.statutory_content_note: Section 146(2)(b) lists what must be explained. It is not caution wording and is shown only as the legal source.

citations.excerpt_contains: in language appropriate to his or her age and understanding
